<!-- nx configuration start-->
When running tasks, always prefer running the task through `nx` (i.e. `nx run`, `nx run-many`, `nx affected`) instead of using the underlying tooling directly. You have access to the Nx MCP server and its tools, use them to help the user. When answering questions about the repository, use the `nx_workspace` tool first to gain an understanding of the workspace architecture where applicable. When working in individual projects, use the `nx_project_details` mcp tool to analyze and understand the specific project structure and dependencies. For questions around nx configuration, best practices or if you're unsure, use the `nx_docs` tool. Always use this instead of assuming things about nx configuration. If the user needs help with an Nx configuration or project graph error, use the `nx_workspace` tool to get any errors.
<!-- nx configuration end-->
Next.js TJ Sokol
